subject: Pilot onboarding: kickoff scheduling and security checklist
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@cobalthealth.com>, Marcus Reed <m.reed@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, procurement@cobalthealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Hi Sophie / Marcus —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot. To get the pilot started we usually run a 60–90 minute kickoff (mix of discovery + short demo + alignment on success metrics, security checklist, and procurement next steps). Attendees we recommend:
- Customer champion (Sophie)
- Customer engineering lead (Marcus)
- Procurement (procurement@cobalthealth.com)
- CISO/security representative (if available)
- AE (me) + SE (Alex) + Solutions/ops (Lauren)

Could you share two 60–90 minute windows next week (your timezone)? We are PST-based but can adapt.

I’ve attached a short agenda and the Redwood SLA one-pager for procurement’s review. If you have a security questionnaire we should pre-read, please attach or link it.

Proposed high-level agenda (attached in doc):
1) 10 min intros + success criteria
2) 25–35 min focused demo (SE)
3) 15–20 min security & data flow Qs (security lead + Dev)
4) 10 min procurement & next steps

Notes: Alex may ask for a short architecture diagram or example logs to tailor the demo — we’ll call that out if needed.

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
